entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:2
segments: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for [his] pride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:5
segments: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and [findeth it] not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:7
segments: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive [in him] the lips of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:11
segments: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good man [shall be satisfied] from himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:22
segments: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth [shall be to] them that devise good.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to penury.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: The crown of the wise is their riches; [But] the folly of fools is [only] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies [causeth] deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:26
segments: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:28
segments: In the multitude of people is the king's glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; But [that which is] in the inward part of fools is made known.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:34
segments: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: The king's favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will be [against] him that causeth shame.
